messages:
Rita (Billing): Heads-up: charge for INV-4991 failed at capture — gateway=decline, code=card_declined. Customer portal shows a pending card update.
Omar (Finance): Any decline_code on the webhook? debit/credit? issuer message?
Priya (Support): Webhook payload: `{"decline_code":"stolen_card","brand":"visa","last4":"1890"}`. Customer attempted a replacement card but didn't finish 3DS.
Evan (AE): Customer is Carelane. They messaged that they tried to update card via portal and got a timeout. I'm going to call them now.
Rita (Billing): Do not attempt additional auto-captures. We'll pause the retry ladder until we confirm new payment method. Current retry policy: 4 attempts at +2h, +8h, +24h, +72h.
billing-bot: auto_retry INV-4991 attempt=1 scheduled=+2h
Priya (Support): Created ticket SUP-8903 for portal timeouts during card update. Marked as P1 if it blocks payment flow.
Evan (AE): On call — customer says corporate procurement needs wire instead of card. Can we accept wire for this invoice and still apply usage credit if needed?
Omar (Finance): Wire is acceptable. Provide wire details and request remittance reference: INV-4991 and account legal name. If wire arrives, we will mark paid and run reconciliation. No credits applied automatically.
Rita (Billing): Wire instructions: Redwood Inference LLC, FirstCloud Bank, Routing 110000111, Account 555566667777, SWIFT: FCBUUS33, Reference: INV-4991. Ask for sender name and bank trace.
Evan (AE): Customer prefers same-day wire. What do we need on our side to fast-track reconciliation?
Rita (Billing): Email payment proof (SWIFT copy) to billing@redwood.ai and cc finance. I will manual-post the payment upon receipt. Also include payment amount and invoice number.
Priya (Support): If they insist on card, advise them to re-enter via portal and complete 3DS. For phone updates we must not take card numbers — refer them to portal link: https://billing.redwood.ai/update?inv=INV-4991
Evan (AE): Noted. I'll send both options on the call. I'll ask procurement to send wire confirmation to billing.
Omar (Finance): Policy Q: do we suspend service for overdue after 5 days for mid-market? I thought 7.
Rita (Billing): Standard is 7 days. For enterprise we extend to 14. Carelane is mid-market — set suspension timer to 7 days. If wire ETA is same-day, we can hold.
billing-bot: account Carelane suspension_timer set=7d
Evan (AE): Customer says they'll attempt wire now. I'll DM them instructions and request SWIFT copy once done.
Priya (Support): Linking SUP-8903 -> INV-4991 and adding note to engineering about intermittent tokenization error.
Rita (Billing): After payment posts, I'll reconcile and close invoice. If wire fails, we resume retry schedule and outreach.
Omar (Finance): Thanks. Please ping here when SWIFT arrives.
Evan (AE): Will update. :thumbsup:
